title: Graduate Apprentice Trainee
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**About The NATS Program**
This role is offered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to equip Indian youth with practical, trade-specific skills. Administered under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended in 1973), this program at Volvo Group offers engineering graduates and diploma holders a structured, 1-year practical, hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunity to build industry-ready capabilities.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Basic Knowledge about RULA, REBA, OWAS, NIOSH lifting equations etc
* Conduct ergonomic risk assessments on production/assembly workstations using Volvo Ergonomics Standard method.
* Develop ergonomic improvement concepts and support their implementation on the shop floor.
* Support in Value added & non-value-added activities study on Production line- Time study, Spaghetti chart for motion study
* Standard operating procedures preparation & frequent validation
* One point lesson preparation & frequent validation
* Additional instructions, Temporary instructions preparation & frequent validation
* Support to work on process & quality issues to have temporary & permanent action
* Working on layout modification preparation/updation in AutoCAD
* Prepare local tooling drawing
* Support in documentation & data analysis

**Who are you?**
You have completed B.E. in Industrial, Production, Mechanical, or Automobile Engineering
  
  
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering
description:
BetaNXT
   

  

 The Company
   

  

 BetaNXT is the next wave in wealth management technology and outsourcing solutions. We focused on solving our customers most demanding integration challenges with flexible, efficient, connected solutions. Our products reduce enterprise cost, streamline operation processes, increase advisor productivity, and enhances the investor experience. Together with BetaNXT, wealth management firms are transforming their platforms into differentiating assets that enable scale and commercial growth.
   

  

 But we're not just invested in our customers; we're also invested in people. We know that our overall success is a combined effort, and we therefore strive to provide opportunities for our employees to learn, grow and thrive.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 BETA is a self\-clearing securities processing solution for wealth management firms. Built on years of expert knowledge and hands\-on experience, BETA provides critical back\-office controls including corporate action management, middle office exception management, and front office account management and trading tools for advisors.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Associate with hands\-on experience in production\-level, cloud\-hosted data\-as\-a\-service application. In this role, you will primarily work on data warehousing\- involving data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL processes including hands on in Data Build Tool (DBT) or any such build tools. You will be responsible for querying using SQL,write functions and stored procedures, and more. On any given day, you might be architecting data ingestion and warehousing solutions, and delivering data to our customers or internal applications through queries and functions. You will follow best practices in code and design, secure coding practices, and review data architecture, modeling, and queries from development through to completion in a live production environment.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development , this role is part of a Scrum team for developing product (s) within the Data Platform team . The role will be involved with developing customer facing cloud hosted data as service products . This role necessitates meetings and require heavy collaboration within and across many teams . Our business model is hybrid, working from our B angalore campus.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Architect and implement data ingestion and warehousing solutions.
* Develop and maintain data models, ETL, and reverse ETL processes.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
* Ensure best practices in code and design, including secure coding practices.
* Review and improve data architecture, modeling, and queries.
* Deliver data solutions to customers and internal applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to meet project goals.


 Your Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in a data\-related software engineering role.
* Experience in Snowflake, DBT models.
* Hands\-on experience with coding, analytical, and data querying knowledge.
* Experience with all phases of the software development life cycle and Agile software development.
* Solid design knowledge to create extensible, reusable data deliveries that meet architectural objectives and security assessments.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and quickly get up to speed.
* Ability to work autonomously and in teams.
* Excitement for new technologies and challenges of scale.
* Proficiency in:
* Data Build Tool (DBT) or any analogous tool
* Data warehousing, including data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL
* SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures
* Various data delivery methodologies (files, streams, APIs)
* Understanding of data\-related application SDKs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools like Terraform.
* Familiarity with AWS
* Knowledge of programming languages such as Python and PowerShell.


 As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. Therefore we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world−regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law.

title: Media Consultant
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission passionately provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across more than 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Join our dynamic team as a Media Consultant, where you will spearhead our PR and media initiatives, driving awareness and support for our impactful causes. This role offers a unique opportunity to utilise your expertise in media strategy, forge partnerships with key stakeholders, and leverage various platforms to amplify the organisation’s message and mission.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop and implement comprehensive media strategies to enhance brand visibility and support organisational objectives.
* Cultivate relationships with editors, journalists, and news channels to secure coverage and promote the organisation’s initiatives.
* Pitch compelling story ideas and press releases to secure positive coverage of organisation's initiatives, events, and milestones.
* Monitor media coverage and industry trends to identify opportunities for strategic engagement and proactive outreach.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with internal teams to ensure alignment of messaging and maximise media impact.
* Provide media training and support to spokespeople and staff members as needed.
* Develop and implement crisis communication plans to effectively manage and mitigate reputational risks in the event of negative media coverage or emergencies.
* Track and analyse media metrics to measure the effectiveness of PR efforts and inform future strategies.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and platforms to innovate media tactics and maintain relevance in a rapidly evolving landscape.
* Develop and manage the annual media budget, allocating resources strategically to maximise ROI and achieve organisational goals.
* Track expenditures and performance against budget targets, providing regular updates and recommendations for adjustments as needed.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
* Proven experience of 6\-8 years in media relations, PR, or journalism, with a focus on strategic planning and execution.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong network of media contacts across print, broadcast, and digital platforms.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated success in securing media coverage and generating positive publicity for organisations or causes.
* Strategic thinker with a creative mindset and the ability to generate innovative ideas for media campaigns.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Experience working in multicultural or international settings, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Adherence to organisational policies and guidelines, including those related to media relations, privacy, and data protection.
* Proficiency in media monitoring tools, analytics platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Passion for social impact and a commitment to the organisation’s mission and values.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* None specified.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 This is a full\-time, work from office based role.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Joining SMSGHM offers a chance to impact marginalised communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across more than 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.
